title: Targeted Synthetic Control Method
abstract: arXiv:2602.04611v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The synthetic control method (SCM) estimates causal effects in panel data with a single-treated unit by constructing a counterfactual outcome as a weighted combination of untreated control units that matches the pre-treatment trajectory. In this paper, we introduce the targeted synthetic control (TSC) method, a new two-stage estimator that directly estimates the counterfactual outcome. Specifically, our TSC method (1) yields a targeted debiasing estimator, in the sense that the targeted updating refines the initial weights to produce more stable weights; and (2) ensures that the final counterfactual estimation is a convex combination of observed control outcomes to enable direct interpretation of the synthetic control weights. TSC is flexible and can be instantiated with arbitrary machine learning models. translated_abstract: 合成控制法（SCM）通过构建一个由未处理控制单元加权组合而成的反事实结果，使其匹配处理前的结果轨迹，从而在具有单一处理单元的面板数据中估计因果效应。在本文中，我们提出了目标化合成控制（TSC）方法，这是一种直接估计反事实结果的新型两阶段估计器。具体而言，我们的TSC方法：（1）产生一个目标化去偏估计器，即通过目标化更新来精炼初始权重，从而产生更稳定的权重；（2）确保最终的反事实估计是观测到的控制结果的凸组合，从而使合成控制权重能够被直接解释。TSC方法灵活多样，可以用任意机器学习模型进行实例化。在方法学上，TSC从一个初始的合成控制权重集合出发，通过一维目标化更新……
tldr: 本文提出目标化合成控制（TSC）方法，一种新型两阶段估计器，通过目标化去偏更新直接估计反事实结果，在保证权重稳定性和凸组合可解释性的同时，可灵活结合任意机器学习模型。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the Targeted Synthetic Control (TSC) method, a novel two-stage estimator that directly estimates counterfactual outcomes via targeted debiasing updates, ensuring stable, convex-combination weights for direct interpretation while remaining flexible enough to incorporate arbitrary machine learning models.
